owns.name: Reading
owns.description: Describes one measured reading and whether it belongs in the report.
owns.declaration: export interface Reading { name: string; value: number; unit: string; included: boolean; }

context.purpose: Defines the reading vocabulary and output behavior.

skills.name: Minimal reading contract
skills.content: Export exactly the planned Reading interface. Keep every property required and add no runtime behavior or extra exports.

constraints: Do not add declarations beyond Reading.

files.task: Format one reading with stable punctuation and spacing.
requirements: formatReading emits the reading name, a colon, its numeric value, and its unit with stable spacing.

owns.name: formatReading
owns.description: Formats one reading name, numeric value, and unit for display.

context.purpose: Defines the exact reading label behavior.

skills.name: NodeNext reading formatter
skills.content: Use an import type for Reading and the exact NodeNext-relative module specifier supplied in the Agent Input. Return the name, colon, value, and unit without mutating the reading.

files.task: Compose the included-reading report from the shared formatter.
requirements: summarizeReadings preserves input order, includes only selected readings, reports the included count, and returns No included readings when none qualify.

owns.name: summarizeReadings
owns.description: Builds the ordered human-readable report of included readings.
owns.declaration: export function summarizeReadings(readings: readonly Reading[]): string;

context.purpose: Defines filtering, ordering, header, and empty behavior.

skills.name: Stable reading report
skills.content: Filter without sorting or mutating. For one included reading use `1 included reading`; otherwise use `{count} included readings`. Put each formatted reading on its own following line. Return exactly `No included readings` when the filtered list is empty.

constraints: Call formatReading(reading) for each included reading.
